---- MODULE DeadBindings ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES x, n
Init == x = 0 /\ n = 0
Next == n < 3 /\ \E a \in BOOLEAN: \E t \in 1..9: \E e \in (IF a THEN {0, 1} ELSE {t % 3, 2}): x' = e /\ n' = n + 1
Small == x + n < 4
====

---- MODULE FrameEnabled ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
F(p) == p
Init == x = 1
Next == x' = x
Safe == ~(F(ENABLED <<\E a \in 1..2 : x' = x>>_x) \/ F(ENABLED <<\E a \in 1..2 : x' = a>>_x))

specifications.step-call:
---- MODULE StepCall ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES x, y
Init == x = 0 /\ y = 0
Next == \E a \in 1..2 : \E b \in 1..3 : LET Act(p) == \E w \in 0..1 : \E u \in 0..2 : x' = (p + w + b) % 4 /\ y' = u % 4 IN Act(a)
====

specifications.deep-action:
---- MODULE DeepAction ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLE x
RECURSIVE Go(_)
Go(n) == IF n = 0 THEN x' = 1 ELSE \E a \in 1..1 : \E b \in 1..1 : Go(n - 1)
Init == x = 0
Next == Go(N)
====
specifications.step-call-args:

VARIABLES x, y
Init == x = 0 /\ y = 0
Next == \E a \in 1..2 : \E b \in 1..3 : LET Act(p) == \E w \in 0..0 : x' = p /\ y' = b + w IN Act(a)
====

Next == x < 2 /\ x' = x + 1 /\ \E a \in 1..100: TRUE
====
